home.rule: Nothing here is our number: no fees, rents or estimates.
home.start: Start: who is travelling with you?

home.scamBanner: Entering the lottery is free and only on the official site. Never pay an agent or an "office".

runway.title: Runway: how much do you need?
runway.lead: Type your monthly costs; we show the savings needed if the job starts on day 1 or is delayed by 1, 2 or 3 months.
runway.incomeLead: Optional. Lets the scenarios tell you how much more to save after what you already have.
runway.bufferHelp: You choose the number of months
runway.scenariosLead: Each scenario = paperwork and fees + moving + (monthly costs × months without income) + buffer − your savings.
runway.note: The highlighted scenario is the one we suggest planning for.

results.lead: All your numbers on one page. Print or save as PDF from the browser.
results.note: These figures come from your own inputs. Check the sources before deciding.
results.timelineLead: Every cost has a due stage. This is the cash that must be ready at each stage, and the running total up to it.
results.forgotLead: The empty fields in each stage. You need not fill them all; just make sure nothing is missing.
results.planLead: A small file on your device, no account. Open it later or compare it with another plan.

quick.title: Quick mode
quick.lead: Just 5 big categories. For the details, switch to "Detailed".
quick.note: Quick and detailed figures are kept separately. The mode you choose is what the summary shows.

compare.note: Both files stay on your device. Nothing is sent.

scam.title: Beware of scams
scam.lead: Everything official in the lottery is free and only on the US government site. Anyone asking for money to "register you" or "guarantee" you is a scammer.
scam.banner: Entering the lottery is free and only on the official site. Never pay an agent or an "office".

facts.1: Entry is 100% free and only at dvprogram.state.gov.
facts.2: You check the result yourself on the official Entrant Status Check. No email, message or call tells you that you won.
facts.3: There are no approved offices or agents. Nobody can raise your chances.
facts.4: Copycat sites look official. Make sure the address ends in .gov.

signs.1: Asks for money to register you or to "guarantee" a win.
signs.2: Tells you that you won by message, email or phone.
signs.3: Asks for a money transfer, card details or your passport before you check the official site.
signs.4: The address does not end in .gov, or the tone is urgent and threatening.

scam.note: This site is not affiliated with the US government. We only point you to the official pages.

guide.title: How do I find the price of food?
guide.lead: We will not give you a number. We show you where to see it yourself, in the city you plan to live in.
guide.step1: Open a supermarket site from the links below and pick a store in your intended city.
guide.step2: Build a one-week basket of what you actually buy and read the total.
guide.step3: Multiply by 4 and type the number into the calculator. Repeat now and then; prices change.
guide.note: These are external sites. We do not set prices and are not responsible for them.
guide.backToCalculator: Type the number into the calculator

guideHealth.title: How do I find the price of health insurance?
guideHealth.lead: We will not give you a number. The price depends on the state, your age, household size and income, and you see it yourself on the official US government site.
guideHealth.step1: Open HealthCare.gov, enter the ZIP code of your intended city, and your household members and ages.
guideHealth.step2: Browse the plans and the monthly premium of each one, and check whether a subsidy applies to your expected income.
guideHealth.step3: Type the monthly premium into the calculator. For children, check Medicaid.gov and the CHIP programme; they may be covered at lower cost.
guideHealth.state: Some states run their own marketplace; HealthCare.gov sends you there automatically. We do not set prices.
